test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers originates in Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Godavari River rises from Trimbakeshwar in the Nashik district of Maharashtra.
 
• It is the oldest River in India.
 
• It is also known as the Ganga of South India.
 
• It is the second-longest river in India.
 
• Dams on the Godavari river are - Polavaram Dam (Andhra Pradesh), Pochampad Dam (Telangana).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Tributaries of Godavari river are - 

 
 
• Indravati (Chattisgarh)
 
• Painganga.
 
• Venganga.
 
• Pranhita
 
 
 
• Cities that lie along the Godavari river are -
 
 
• Nasik, Nanded (Maharashtra).
 
• Bhadrachalam ( Andhra Pradesh).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a964872f2447684d0758dfe7fe644bc5755a2e862edb380bb041fdd9f5e50fc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Sources of some important Rivers of India -

 
 
• Brahmaputra - Kailash Mansarover Lake
 
• Indus - Kailash Mansarover Lake
 
• Jhelum - Seshnag Lake
 
• Chenab - Bara-la-cha Pass
 
• Ravi - Rohtang Pass
 
• Sutluj - Kailash Mountain
 
• Ganga - Gangotri
 
• Narmada - Maikal Hills
